architectural_units.name: Partner
architectural_units.description: Third-party companies that offer digital signage service/consultancy using Waapiti technology.

architectural_units.name: Player
architectural_units.description: Computer equipment that acts as an intermediary between the Waapiti platform and the audiovisual support.

architectural_units.name: Waapiti Platform
architectural_units.description: Scalable, web-based platform that allows automatic distribution of content and management of players.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: The layer that communicates with the user, displaying system data and collecting user input.

architectural_units.name: Domain Layer
architectural_units.description: The layer that contains the business logic, processing information and performing necessary operations.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: The layer that contains the information.

architectural_units.name: React Native
architectural_units.description: Framework used to develop the mobile application.

architectural_units.name: Redux
architectural_units.description: Library used to manage the application state.

architectural_units.name: AWS SNS
architectural_units.description: Service used for the delivery of push notifications.

architectural_units.name: NestJS
architectural_units.description: Progressive NodeJS framework for building efficient, reliable, and scalable backend applications.
The mobile application interacts with the Waapiti API using HTTP requests.
The Waapiti server communicates with the database and other services hosted on AWS.
The application uses AWS SNS for the delivery of push notifications.
The application uses sockets to receive logs in real time from the server.
The application uses sockets to show content in real time from the server.

patterns.name: 3-Layer Architecture
patterns.description: The architecture follows the 3-layer model: Presentation, Domain, and Data.

patterns.name: Flux
patterns.description: Architecture for managing and flowing data in a web application, designed to replace MVC.

patterns.name: Observer
patterns.description: Design pattern to observe the state of an object in a program, reflected in the Flux architecture where stores act as subjects.

patterns.name: Decorator
patterns.description: Design pattern that allows adding behavior to an object, used to extend component functionality for testing.
